docs_required: Government-issued photo ID
Proof of Social Security number (SSN card, W-2, or tax document)
Proof of address tied to the property (utility bill, bank statement, tax return, or mail from the company that reported the property)
states.source_url: FDIC unclaimed-property-by-state list (derived from missingmoney.com / NAUPA), retrieved 2026-09-19; spot corrections verified same day
